info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Status Retrieval API provides essential insights into student enrollment statuses across various educational programs. By querying this endpoint, users can access real-time information regarding enrollment states, facilitating better decision-making for educational institutions and stakeholders. Typical consumers include educational administrators, management systems, and reporting tools that require accurate enrollment metrics for operational purposes. This API plays a critical role in monitoring and enhancing the enrollment process within the educational sector.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of enrollments. It provides insights into the enrollment process and indicates whether enrollments are active, pending, or closed.

requestBody.description: Request body for the retrieval of enrollment status. The payload should conform to the specified schema which outlines the expected parameters for the operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the enrollment status is returned.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation regarding enrollment status.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.title: Enrollment Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the enrollment operation.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the enrollment.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the enrollment operation.

state.description: The current state of the enrollment process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the enrollment request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the enrollment operation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.description: Response schema for the enrollment status API endpoint, including the status of the operation and related details.
